finding.scope: (g,n)=(6,6), genus-six degree-four covers of P^1 with F=O(4)+O(5); applies to any downstream use of the branch map to M_{0,18} or Conf_18.
finding.statement: Any construction over the balanced tetragonal locus that needs a SIMPLY-BRANCHED balanced cover must cite CLM-0112-4 (or the Bujokas-Patel genericity recorded parenthetically in FND-0163), and may not rely on the packet's own nonemptiness witness. Composing FND-0154 with FND-0158: the packet's self-contained witness for nonemptiness of H^bal is a cover composed through an elliptic curve, and no cover factoring nontrivially is simply branched, so that witness lies entirely outside the simply-branched locus. Existence of a simply-branched balanced cover therefore follows only from purity of dimension 15 of Hbar^bal (FND-0162) together with the codimension-one bound on the non-simply-branched locus, and every argument that places a Hurwitz chart etale over M_{0,18} inside the balanced locus inherits that hinge.
